characters.name: Detective Miles Corbin
characters.appearance: A man in his late 40s to early 50s with a lean, strong build. He has a perpetually tired yet sharp gaze in his deep-set, intelligent eyes. His face is chiseled, often shadowed by a faint five o'clock stubble, hinting at long nights. He typically wears a classic, slightly rumpled beige trench coat, collar often turned up, and a well-creased dark fedora pulled low over his brow. Underneath, a dark suit and a loosened tie complete his professional yet worn-out look. His posture is often slightly hunched, suggesting years of carrying the weight of the city's darkness.

voice_profile.tone: Gravelly, serious, world-weary, with an underlying current of dry wit
voice_profile.accent: Classic Mid-Atlantic American accent, reminiscent of 1940s-50s Hollywood noir

characters.name: Eleanor Albright
characters.appearance: Eleanor Albright is a woman of striking, timeless beauty, appearing in her early to mid-30s. Her raven-black hair is impeccably styled in sophisticated, soft waves that frame her face, or gathered into a chic updo. Her eyes are a captivating shade of emerald green, sharp and intelligent, often holding a deep, enigmatic quality that hints at hidden depths. She has a refined, fair complexion and elegantly sculpted features. Her figure is slender and graceful, accentuated by her impeccable taste in classic 1940s-era fashion: tailored dark silk or velvet gowns, sharp-shouldered suits, often adorned with a subtle strand of pearls or long gloves. Her demeanor is always composed, carrying an air of quiet sophistication and a subtle, intriguing melancholy.

voice_profile.tone: Calm, alluring, with a hint of world-weariness and quiet confidence

characters.name: Slick' Eddie
characters.appearance: A man in his late 40s or early 50s with a lean, wiry build. His dark, thinning hair is meticulously slicked back, often hidden beneath the brim of a slightly worn but sharp fedora. He favors dark, well-cut suits that, while once expensive, now show signs of moderate wear. His eyes are sharp, darting, and perpetually assessive, often accompanied by a knowing, almost predatory smirk that plays on his thin lips. He carries himself with a casual confidence, every movement economical and purposeful.

voice_profile.tone: Smooth, confident, and slightly oily, with a conversational cadence that can easily shift into a conspiratorial whisper or a thinly veiled threat. There's an underlying cynicism that colors his every word.
voice_profile.accent: Urban American (e.g., subtle New York or Chicago inflections)
